mapper.sql: D.IDOCU_NO, D.IPROM_NO, D.SITEM, D.SGRP_TITLE, D.STITLE, D.SCONTENTS, D.SREASON, D.SSEARCH_TEXT, D.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, D.SDISP_YN, D.SSTART_DT, D.SINS_DT, D.SSYS_ID
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_DOCU D, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT D2.IDOCU_NO FROM TB_DOCU D2, ( SELECT PR2.IPROM_NO, PD.SITEM FROM TB_PROM PR2, ( SELECT MAX(P2.ILAW_NO) AS LAW_NO, D3.SITEM AS SITEM FROM TB_PROM P2, TB_DOCU D3 WHERE P2.IPROM_NO = D3.IPROM_NO AND P2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND P2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} GROUP BY D3.SITEM ) PD WHERE PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO = PD.LAW_NO ) PRD WHERE D2.IPROM_NO = PRD.IPROM_NO AND D2.SITEM = PRD.SITEM ) D_MAX WHERE D.IDOCU_NO = D_MAX.IDOCU_NO AND D.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND ( D.SDISP_YN = 'Y' OR ( NVL(D.SDISP_YN,'Y') = 'N' AND PR.ILAW_NO = #{lawNo} ) ) ORDER BY D.SDISP_YN DESC, D.SITEM ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DOCU ( IDOCU_NO, IPROM_NO, SITEM, SGRP_TITLE, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SSEARCH_TEXT, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SDISP_YN, SINS_DT, SSTART_DT ) VALUES ( #{docuNo}, #{promNo}, #{item}, NVL(#{grpTitle}, ' '), #{title}, #{contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{searchText,jdbcType=CLOB}, NVL(#{gaejungType}, 'NEW'), NVL(#{dispYn}, 'Y'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), NVL(#{startDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_DOCU SET STITLE = #{title}, SCONTENTS = #{contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, SREASON = #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, SGAEJUNG_TYPE = #{gaejungType}, SDISP_YN = NVL(#{dispYn}, 'Y') WHERE IDOCU_NO = #{docuNo}
